core.store.note: P1-02 ships the 0600 file store with surfaced failures and store_status() (file or indexeddb, degraded not-persistent). PKeyCore picks a platform store by default when its plugin is present (Keychain, then Keystore, then the file store): iOS, P5-05's Keychain store (core/store/keychain_store.gd, PKeyKeychainStore over PKeyApple: device id and token AfterFirstUnlockThisDeviceOnly with no access group); Android, P5-06's Keystore store (core/store/keystore_store.gd, PKeyKeystoreStore over PKeyAndroid: one AndroidKeyStore AES-256-GCM key per product, StrongBox where present, blobs in noBackupFilesDir, a lost key surfaced and re-enrolled). Both migrate from the file store and surface failures as keyring-error. No work package owns a desktop keyring, so the desktop runtimes keep the file store.

license.manage.note: PX-W8: the device-limit result exposes manageUrl (validated), plus the return and key helpers.

config.resolve.note: OS.get_environment drops a leading U+FEFF from a value, so on a Godot host the two U+FEFF rows of config-matrix.json hold for the resolver, not for the process environment. A number's value is Godot's own reading, which is not correctly rounded, and a string value's \u0000 reads as U+FFFD (both WIRE-CONTRACT-V3 §10); verdicts are unaffected.

devices.fingerprint.note: PKeyFingerprint: per-platform readers as pure parsers over captured output, the capture on a WorkerThreadPool task once a session; the desktop device id hashes MachineGuid (Windows), IOPlatformUUID (macOS) and the rule-2 machine-id (Linux).

devices.report.note: The report also carries the Godot keys engine and outlet (the Worker bounds them; outlet is PKeyCore.reported_outlet()), and the updater's queued update events in updates (P6-03, P3-10).

devices.attest.note: P6-02: PolarisKey.devices.attest() (services/devices.gd) posts devices/attest/challenge, then devices/attest with an App Attest attestation (PKeyApple.app_attest over PolarisKeyPlatform's DCAppAttestService ops, clientDataHash = SHA-256 of the challenge's requestHash; the key id kept in the Keychain, re-attested with a fresh key when a reinstall, migration or restore killed it) or a standard Play Integrity token (PKeyAndroid.integrity_token over polaris-key-platform's play flavour, the requestHash verbatim, the cloud project number from the challenge or PKeyOptions.play_cloud_project_number). Unsupported runtime on desktop and web (and where App Attest does not run, the simulator); outlet on an iOS install that is not App Store or TestFlight, an Android install Google Play did not make or the direct plugin build, and a mobile build without the native plugin. Server codes are surfaced verbatim.

identity.oidc.note: Native Godot has no completion path for the OIDC redirect; see P1-07, which ships device-code sign-in instead.

identity.devicecode.note: PolarisKey.identity (P1-07): begin_sign_in with background polling on the server's cadence, cancel, the opt-in confirm-identity step and licence attach, and a pure-GDScript QR encoder with PKeyQrRect for verification_uri_complete. On web it runs too (OS.shell_open becomes window.open; Worker CORS needed).

update.content.note: P4-24: core/feed.gd feed_content (packSets, packFloors, revocations parsed beside the claims with the token rule), distribution/decision.gd's content decision (select_pack_rows, composition, prestage, content-floor, revoked-content, packs; boot required only for revoked required content), services/update/flow.gd content steps 10-14; every feedContentCases and contentRows vector, stamp holds, on the editor and the release template.

update.driver.note: P3-10: one adapter per outlet kind (distribution/outlets/, PKeyOutletAdapter): store kinds open the https listing or PKeyOptions.update_page_url, platform kinds stay silent with their own message, web reloads, direct dispatches binary.method to the Sparkle, Velopack, WinSparkle or AppImageUpdate bridge (a missing plugin degrades to the build's download link from distribution.endpoints.builds), stages a verified sidecar .pck (updater/sidecar_swap.gd, Range resume through PKeyDownload) and restarts into it without --main-pack. Inert in the editor, headless runs and debug builds. P5-07: the bridges reach GDScript facades (addons/polaris_key/native/: PKeySparkle, PKeyVelopack, PKeyWinSparkle, PKeyStoreContext) over optional GDExtensions in sdks/godot/native/ (macOS Sparkle bridge; one Windows DLL with Velopack, WinSparkle and StoreContext; the Velopack launcher shim), each unsupported with runtime or dependency when unusable; ms-store hooks StoreContext in a Store MSIX. Velopack needs public delivery for now: the Worker's package route is a cross-origin 302 that drops Authorization (S-11 §5.2), so under licensed or entitled delivery a 401/403 download answers unsupported (product). Suite native_desktop; the native-desktop workflow runs the updates end to end. Android (P5-06): the play and play-testing adapters drive Play In-App Updates through PKeyAndroid (native/pkey_android.gd over the PolarisKeyAndroid plugin and polaris-key-platform's play flavour: flexible or immediate by the decision's urgency, complete a downloaded update, silent while Play stages, the listing on any failure or a non-Play install); direct builds offer binary {method: native} through the apk bridge (available only on a direct-flavour build with the plugin): the direct adapter runs PKeyUpdater.install_apk (updater/apk_update.gd: the record's APK downloaded into user://, checked against the verified record's payload size and SHA-256, then PKeyAndroid.apk_install, the verified PackageInstaller self-update with the outcome journaled for the next launch), opening the download link only when the plugin answers unsupported.

update.bootguard.note: P3-10: updater/slots.gd (staged, current, previous and state.json under user://pkey/<product>/updates/) and updater/boot_guard.gd, run in PKeyBoot's GUARD: bootGuardAction over the host's own count, a restart before guard.done after a swap or a rollback, two failed boots roll back and record skipVersion, BOOT_OK_SECONDS and confirm_boot() per the stage-matrix v2 confirmation rows; every copy is read back from disk before a swap or rollback. update_downloaded, update_applied, update_confirmed and boot_rolled_back go out on devices/report's updates key (P6-03's boundedUpdates shape), queued in state.json until reported.

outlet.detect.note: distribution/outlet.gd PKeyOutlet.detect_outlet over distribution/outlet_signals.gd (Flatpak, snap, AppImage, Steam library and environment, itch receipt, macOS receipt and Mach-O leaf, Caskroom, Windows path conventions, Android getInstallSourceInfo through JavaClassWrapper (PKeyAndroid.install_source() reads the same facts, plus the initiator's full signer set, through the P5-06 plugin), web display mode); iOS reads AppDistributor (raced against 2 s, every launch), embedded.mobileprovision and ALTBundleIdentifier through the Apple plugin's facade (native/pkey_apple.gd, P5-05; no evidence without the plugin or before the launch read arrives); the Windows package reader is a hook that answers unavailable until a Windows native reader lands. PKeyCore.update_outlet() feeds the decision and PKeyCore.reported_outlet() the device report; PolarisKey.update.outlet() and detected() expose the result, as client.update.outlet and detected do in Node and Python.

packs.record.note: P4-08: core/release_record.gd applies the pack claims and pin.kind (PKeyPackClaims), packs/marker.gd verifies embedded-pack markers; the packs suite drives every packRecordCases and markerCases vector, the content stamps and packSetIdCases.

packs.revoke.note: P4-24: core/release_record.gd revocation_of / verify_revocation / newer_revocation (every revocationCases vector), packs/revocations.gd (the sibling content/revocations.json: written only with a first entry and revocationsStored first, re-verified on load, torn quarantined with relearn, unreadable writes nothing, the 256 cap, recover_state clears relearn) and the engine's pack-revoked.

packs.delegation.note: P4-26: core/release_record.gd verify_release_record (the delegated path, steps 13 and 16), verify_delegation (cached per hash and trust inputs), record_revoked; packs/dataonly.gd data_only_refusal with Amendment A1 (strict UTF-8 by hand, the text rule); the PackEngine fetches delegations only on the delegated surface (at most 16 per call), refuses non-data-only delegated installs with pack-not-data-only (before any payload fetch, while writing, and on a noop reuse), keeps the install's delegation and reloads through it, refuses releases under a revoked delegation (pack-revoked, detail delegation), never plans the GDDL route for delegated bytes and never mounts a delegated install; step 11 delegation relevance and the decision-input expansion in PKeyUpdateFlow; every delegationCases and dataOnlyCases vector on the editor and the release template.

packs.plan.note: P4-08: packs/select.gd (select_variant, plan_target, plan), a port of client-core; every plan-matrix.json (v2) row, variant case and target case on the editor and the release template; plan_target applies the P4-10 §2.5 chunk rule over the chunk index the engine stages (P4-11).

packs.index.files.note: P4-08: packs/files.gd (parse_files_index, check_paths, tree_digest) over PackedByteArray.decompress; every pathCases and filesIndexCases vector.

packs.index.chunks.note: P4-11: packs/chunks.gd parse_chunk_index / parse_chunk_index_bytes over PackedByteArray.decode_u32/decode_u16 (a u64 is two u32 reads composed and saturated at 2^53, never decode_u64), the zstd index through PackedByteArray.decompress with its exact size; every chunkIndexCases vector on the editor and the release template (4.4.1 and 4.7.2).

packs.apply.full.note: P4-08: packs/apply.gd apply_full (buffered: decompress cannot stream, so PKeyPacks.one_shot_budget can drop a too-large full before planning); applyCases on the editor and the release template.

packs.apply.file.note: P4-08: packs/apply.gd apply_file with the type-neutral container rebuild from gaps and blobs; a godot.pck installed without a kept index derives its files from its own PCK directory, so the next release can come by file.

packs.apply.chunk.note: P4-11: packs/chunks.gd apply_chunk (seed map, the planner's run rule, one single-range request per run, every fetched chunk decoded and verified, the repair pass) and chunk_range_fetch (Range bytes=o-e with If-Range on the bundle hash over HTTPClient with Accept-Encoding: identity, PKeyPackHttp.open_range pulling the body; only an exact 206 Content-Range, clipped at the object's end, and an ETag equal to the bundle hash are read, anything else falls back; no multi-range; Authorization dropped on a cross-origin redirect). PKeyPackEngine lists chunk in its strategies: seeds from this pack's installs, every other pack's active and previous installs and the embedded baselines, whose indexes are kept in <root>/index/<sha256> (backfilled after each ensure, re-verified at every use, collected with their installs); the target index staged before planning; the run bitmap in staging/<planId>/journal.json, re-hashed on resume; a refused range falls back, an interrupted one resumes at the next ensure. Delegated releases (trees) never plan chunk. Every chunk applyCases vector on the editor and the release template.

packs.apply.delta.note: P4-08: zstd --patch-from frames decoded by the ENGINE's own GDDL delta decoder (a PACK_FILE_DELTA helper pack over a private-namespace prefix: a trailer appended to the installed store pack and truncated back, or a copy host), after the window check; advertised (zstd-patch-from) only on the pinned engines PKeyPackZstd.PATCH_FROM_ENGINES (4.6, 4.7) whose start-up probe decodes. On the 4.4 floor the planner never chooses a delta and the corpus's decode cases fail closed (delta-apply-failed).

packs.delta.feed.note: P4-31: core/feed.gd feed_content reads the deltas menu (plans/P4-29.md §2.2: both caps and both uniqueness rules counting dropped entries, a forward scope dropped alone, integer claims through PKeyClaims.is_wire_integer); packs/select.gd with_feed_deltas; PKeyPackEngine.feed_deltas (PKeyPacks wires the menu of the feed the last update check committed, else the cached committed feed) tries at most one feed-offered delta per install, falls back after a 404 or any verdict, journals feedDelta and merges it again on resume, and re-plans a journal whose delta is unknown. Godot has no native payload port, so there is no native path. Every feedContentCases deltas check, feedDeltaCases and feedDeltaApplyCases vector on the editor and the release template.

packs.state.note: P4-08: packs/state.gd and PKeyPackEngine (client-core's PackEngine) over PKeyPackStorage in user://pkey (staging, store/<sha256>.pck, trees/<sha256>/, content/state.json): journal, Range/If-Range resume, read-back before every rename, torn-state quarantine with its saved snapshot, unreadable-state refusal, deferred installs, GC roots, embedded baselines from res://pkey_packs/; packSetId on devices/report; the shared boot guard rolls a failed pack set back with the binary and holds each rolled-back record (held, with a count) until the stamp pins another (pack-rolled-back on ensure).

packs.handlers.note: P4-08: PolarisKey.update.packs.register_handler; files.tree (hot, versioned directory plus pointer swap) and godot.pck (restart; the header and directory checks before commit and mount: normal paths only, resources judged by content (RSRC/text head; RSCC decompressed, bounded, then scanned, P4-27), remap/import targets and uid_cache.bin entries inside the pack; files.tree outputs content-scanned too; mounted in mountOrder, one per frame after the first frame, replace_files=true, from content-addressed paths) built in. P4-16: godot.zip, data.json and l10n.table built in, audio.bank and custom.* registered by the game; a tree handler's base check_tree runs the v1 tree rule (PKeyPck.tree_check) before the type's check_payload, so a custom.* handler never relaxes it; a type refusal is pack-type-check-failed (the detail token in the message, the path in detail.path).

packs.provides.note: P4-20: packs/provides.gd (PKeyPackProvides): provides_of reads a verified record's reserved record-level provides (absent or unusable provides nothing); PolarisKey.update.packs.is_available(content_id) answers from the running set (embedded baselines included) and pack_for(content_id, targets) (a coroutine) from the stamp's pins or a packs decision's targets, reading only records (an install's verified record, else fetched by hash and verified as preflight does); an unentitled pack never answers.

packs.type.godot.zip.note: P4-16: packs/godot_zip_handler.gd (PKeyGodotZipHandler, built in): a stored zip read from its bytes (end record closing the file, no comment, ZIP64, encryption or data descriptor, STORE only, local headers agreeing, no overlap, normal unique paths), then the godot.pck admission list over handler.prefixes; stored as store/<sha256>.zip (named by its leading bytes) and mounted by mount() with the godot.pck packs.

packs.type.l10n.table.note: P4-16: packs/l10n_table_handler.gd and l10n_parse.gd (built in): PO, CSV and JSON tables by plain parsers (format by content, never extension), BCP-47 locale matched to the variant; activation adds code-built Translation objects to the TranslationServer and a swap, rollback or deactivation removes the previous install's; plural forms through Translation on 4.6+, singular only before; no .translation load, no Plural-Forms evaluation.

packs.type.data.json.note: P4-16: packs/data_json_handler.gd (built in): every file strict JSON (PKeyJson) with an object at the top, whatever its name; format versions the host lists (default [1]); documents(pack_id) and on_activate/on_deactivate.

packs.type.audio.bank.note: P4-16: packs/audio_bank_handler.gd (PKeyAudioBankHandler, registered by the game with its middleware, version and reload/unload callables): bank.json's middleware and major.minor against the host's; hot when reload is given, else restart; banks never mounted.

packs.type.ml.model.note: P4-16: Godot has no ML runtime; a game that adds one registers its own handler.

packs.transport.apple.note: P5-08: packs/transport_apple_ba.gd (PKeyPackAppleBaTransport) over P5-05's PKeyApple: the level's asset pack <pack>-c<contentApi> (dots to hyphens), files under pkey/<asset pack>/ resolved with url(for:) every call and never persisted, ensure_packs with progress forwarded; the engine verifies the marker and the payload or treeDigest against the signed record before activation, floats a later release at boot, and plans a carried pack only through the platform (plan-transport-unsupported while it is unavailable). Stub-proven in suite_transports against the fake PolarisKeyApple native; the TestFlight device run is the owner's (P5-08 owner checklist). macOS answers Unsupported (runtime): no work package owns a macOS binding (P5-05 Out).

packs.transport.play.note: P5-08: packs/transport_play_pad.gd (PKeyPackPlayPadTransport) over P5-06's PKeyAndroid: the Play asset pack named by the pack id with dots and hyphens as underscores, its assetsPath re-read every launch (pkey/ or a pkey#tcf_* directory), pack_fetch to COMPLETED, a host confirm_hook before Play's dialog for WAITING_FOR_WIFI / REQUIRES_USER_CONFIRMATION, Unsupported (outlet) on the direct build; a delivered copy must be the pinned release (Play asset packs ship with the bundle). Stub-proven in suite_transports against the fake PolarisKeyAndroid plugin; the internal-track device run is the owner's (P5-08 owner checklist).

packs.transport.steam.note: P5-08: packs/transport_steam.gd (PKeyPackSteamTransport) over GodotSteam when present: <install dir>/pkey_packs/<pack id>/ read only (never written), DLC packs gated on isDLCInstalled and installed with installDLC / dlc_installed, build id and beta branch for diagnostics, Unsupported (dependency) without GodotSteam; a content-only build's later release floats at boot. Stub-proven in suite_transports against a fake GodotSteam; the test-branch device run is the owner's (P5-08 owner checklist).

packs.transport.msix.note: No work package owns an MSIX transport for Godot (program README §9).

packs.transport.flatpak.note: No work package owns a Flatpak transport for Godot (program README §9).

ui.stages.note: PKeyStages (core/stages.gd) replays every stage-matrix.json row, probe, guard and confirm case; PKeyBoot drives every row through PolarisKey.boot() with a scripted host (suite_boot).

ui.kit.note: P1-10's v1 kit: PKeyBoot, gate, activation panel, sign-in dialog with QR, offline activation, settings panel, status banner, update prompt, entitlement badge and dev-menu section, pinned as structural snapshots and centred at five window sizes (suite_ui); a neutral default look over the game's theme, with opt-in Polaris Key branding and an optional Powered-by badge (PKeyOptions.ui_*, PKeyUiTheme; suite_brand). PKeyDeviceList is not in v1 (unowned; needs P1-05) and the pack progress UI is P4-08's.

ui.kit.manage.note: PX-W8: the activation panel shows Free up a device on device-limit, or a QR when a joypad is the only input (suite_ui).

commerce.receipt.note: PolarisKey.commerce (services/commerce.gd, P6-01): get_binding() (the licence's purchase binding — P5-05 PKeyApple's appAccountToken, godot-google-play-billing's obfuscatedAccountId, GodotSteam's getAuthTicketForWebApi identity — and the mapped store products) and claim(store, payload) for the StoreKit JWS, the Play purchase token or the Steam web-API ticket; the Worker verifies with the store and grants the licence flag. hidden_here() applies App Store 3.1.3(b) on Apple outlets. suite_commerce and the commerce-claim transcript (suite_transcripts).
